title: Kuboando
comment: Kuboando — The Kubo-Ando mean generalizes geometric mean to matrices and preserves key properties (e.g. concavity and arithmetic-geometric inequality). https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/BF01371042.pdf
alt_text: Kuboando. The Kubo-Ando mean generalizes geometric mean to matrices and preserves key properties (e.g. concavity and arithmetic-geometric inequality).

title: Implicitexplicit
comment: Implicitexplicit — Comparison of explicit vs implicit descent to minimize a function. Explicit l1 is equivalent to a coordinate descent, and L2 is the usual gradient descent. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Explicit_and_implicit_methods
alt_text: Implicitexplicit. Comparison of explicit vs implicit descent to minimize a function. Explicit l1 is equivalent to a coordinate descent, and L2 is the usual gradient descent.

title: Dikstra
comment: Dikstra — Dijkstra's algorithm computes the geodesic distance on a graph in O(n log(n)) operations using a front propagation algorithm. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dijkstra%27s_algorithm
alt_text: Dikstra. Dijkstra's algorithm computes the geodesic distance on a graph in O(n log(n)) operations using a front propagation algorithm.

title: Colors

title: Eigenfaces
comment: Eigenfaces — Eigenfaces are singular vectors of an image dataset. A principal components analysis is applied to reduce dimensionality and perform face recognition. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eigenface
alt_text: Eigenfaces. Eigenfaces are singular vectors of an image dataset. A principal components analysis is applied to reduce dimensionality and perform face recognition.

title: Nphard
comment: Nphard — NP-complete problems are problems in NP which are NP-hard. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NP-hardness
alt_text: Nphard. NP-complete problems are problems in NP which are NP-hard.

title: Brenier
comment: Brenier — Brenier's theorem solves the long standing question of existence of an optimal transport map, under the hypothesis that the source distribution is non-singular (has a density). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transportation_theory_(mathematics
alt_text: Brenier. Brenier's theorem solves the long standing question of existence of an optimal transport map, under the hypothesis that the source distribution is non-singular (has a density).

title: Shannon
comment: Shannon — Classic reference: C. Shannon, 1949, Communication in the presence of noise. States the Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem. Explains the aliasing of signals. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyquist%E2%80%93Shannon_sampling_theorem
alt_text: Shannon. Classic reference: C. Shannon, 1949, Communication in the presence of noise. States the Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem. Explains the aliasing of signals.

title: Marginals
comment: Marginals — A joint distribution encodes the dependencies between its two marginal distributions (here in the simple case of a density with respect to a product of measures). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marginal_distribution
alt_text: Marginals. A joint distribution encodes the dependencies between its two marginal distributions (here in the simple case of a density with respect to a product of measures).

title: Shepard
comment: Shepard — Shepard interpolation is a surprisingly simple multi-dimensional interpolation method. It uses singular radial basis functions inversely proportional to the distances to the samples. Nearest neighbor interpolation is the limit case. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inverse_distance_weighting
alt_text: Shepard. Shepard interpolation is a surprisingly simple multi-dimensional interpolation method. It uses singular radial basis functions inversely proportional to the distances to the samples. Nearest neighbor interpolation is the limit case.

title: Subdivision Shemes

title: Nlmeans
comment: Nlmeans — Classic reference: A. Buades, B. Coll, J-M. Morel, A review of image denoising algorithms, with a new one, 2005. Non-local means computes an adaptive filtering by comparing patches in images. Started a whole field of research. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Non-local_means

title: Ot Colors
comment: Ot Colors — The color palette of an image is the 3D empirical distribution of the pixels. Optimal transport allows one to interpolate between palettes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palette_(computing
alt_text: Ot Colors. The color palette of an image is the 3D empirical distribution of the pixels. Optimal transport allows one to interpolate between palettes.

title: Poisson Disk
comment: Poisson Disk — Poisson disk process exhibits blue noise power spectrum which is ideal for sampling. Poisson process exhibits clustering (white noise). Hexagonal grid suffers from periodicity (spiky spectrum) which results in aliasing. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supersampling#Poisson_disc
alt_text: Poisson Disk. Poisson disk process exhibits blue noise power spectrum which is ideal for sampling. Poisson process exhibits clustering (white noise). Hexagonal grid suffers from periodicity (spiky spectrum) which results in aliasing.

title: Morse Smale
comment: Morse Smale — Classic reference: Stephen Smale, On gradient dynamical systems, 1961. The Morse-Smale complex segment the space in cells where integral curves of a gradient fields joins stationary points of the fields. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morse%E2%80%93Smale_system
alt_text: Morse Smale. Classic reference: Stephen Smale, On gradient dynamical systems, 1961. The Morse-Smale complex segment the space in cells where integral curves of a gradient fields joins stationary points of the fields.

title: Backprop
